summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that Tom Allen, ex-champion pugilist, arrested for firing a revolver in front of his saloon at Seventh and Market streets, had his case before Judge Peabody continued until April 30.

facts.fact: Allen was arrested at about 2 a.m. for shooting off a revolver in front of his saloon at Seventh and Market streets, charged with disturbing the peace and discharging firearms; his case before Judge Peabody was continued until April 30
